donate.title: Support Keleier Breiz hag ar Bed
donate.intro: Keleier Breiz hag ar Bed is an independent newspaper, written in Breton for everyone. Your support helps us keep publishing news, history and culture in Breton.
donate.whatTitle: What does your donation pay for?
items: Writing and translating new articles, in Breton, French and English
Growing the site and making it better known
donate.how: You choose the amount. Payment takes place on PayPal's secure page: we never receive your bank details.
donate.soon: The donation button will open very soon. Thank you for your patience!
donate.note: A donation is not a subscription: it does not give access to subscriber-only articles. To read everything:
